items.name: machine-ui-base
items.title: machine-ui base
items.description: Maps machine-ui tokens onto Tailwind utilities and adds base styles and animations. Pair it with a theme-* item.

items.name: theme-console
items.title: Console theme
items.description: The console preset (IBM Plex Mono + IBM Plex Sans), light and dark, with every colour pair contrast-solved. Load its fonts separately.

items.name: theme-graphite
items.title: Graphite theme
items.description: The graphite preset (Geist), light and dark, with every colour pair contrast-solved. Load its fonts separately.

items.name: theme-harbor
items.title: Harbor theme
items.description: The harbor preset (Public Sans), light and dark, with every colour pair contrast-solved. Load its fonts separately.

items.name: theme-folio
items.title: Folio theme
items.description: The folio preset (Instrument Serif + Instrument Sans), light and dark, with every colour pair contrast-solved. Load its fonts separately.

items.name: theme-bloom
items.title: Bloom theme
items.description: The bloom preset (Bricolage Grotesque + Figtree), light and dark, with every colour pair contrast-solved. Load its fonts separately.

items.name: theme-forge
items.title: Forge theme
items.description: The forge preset (Archivo Black + Archivo), light and dark, with every colour pair contrast-solved. Load its fonts separately.

items.name: machine-ui-styles
items.title: Machine Ui Styles
items.description: Shared class fragments machine-ui components use for focus, fields, menus and floating surfaces.

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: Use Reduced Motion
items.description: True when the person prefers reduced motion; use it for motion driven from JavaScript.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of headings that each reveal a section. One or several sections can be open.

items.name: agent-glyph
items.title: Agent Glyph
items.description: The agent’s mark, used as its avatar beside messages and activity. Takes the theme’s primary colour.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal that interrupts to confirm a consequential action. It only closes through its buttons or Escape.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline banner with a title and a description, in default, success, warning and destructive variants.

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Approval Card
items.description: The agent asks before it acts: a question, a few options and Confirm or Skip.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Keeps media at a fixed shape as its width changes.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Shows a person as a photo or initials, alone or as an overlapping group.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label for state or category, in primary, secondary, outline and destructive styles.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Shows where a page sits in the hierarchy, with a collapsed middle for long trails.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Joins related buttons into one row with shared edges, including split buttons.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action. Six variants and four sizes, with icon, loading and disabled states.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a single date or a range, with today marked and keyboard navigation.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Groups related content on a raised surface. Whether it uses a border or a shadow comes from the theme’s separation setting.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A row of slides with previous and next buttons, swipe, and arrow-key support.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts with theme colours, gridlines and tooltips. Series colours come from the chart tokens.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Turns an option on or off. Supports an indeterminate state for "some selected".

items.name: citation
items.title: Citation
items.description: Numbered markers in an answer that preview their source, and the list of sources underneath.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code with a filename header and a copy button, for agent output and docs.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A single trigger that shows or hides the content beneath it.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A select with a filter field: type to narrow the options, then pick one.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable list of actions with groups and shortcuts. Use CommandDialog to open it as a palette.

items.name: confidence-bar
items.title: Confidence Bar
items.description: How sure the agent is, as a bar plus a word (high, medium, low), so colour is never the only signal.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu of actions that opens at the pointer when its area is right-clicked or long-pressed.

items.name: copy-input
items.title: Copy Input
items.description: A read-only field with a copy button, for API keys, webhook URLs and share links.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A table with sorting, filtering, row selection and pagination, built on TanStack Table.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A button that opens a Calendar and shows the chosen date in short form.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window over the page. Focus moves inside, Escape closes it and focus returns to the trigger.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A bottom sheet with a drag handle, for mobile-first flows. Swipe down or press Escape to close.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions below a trigger, with icons, shortcuts, checkbox items, submenus and a destructive style.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A placeholder for a view with nothing in it yet: what it is for, and the one action to start.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Lays out a label, control, help text and error for one form field, so every form reads the same way.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A floating preview shown while the pointer rests on, or focus is on, its trigger.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: A text field with a fixed prefix, suffix or icon inside one border.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input Otp
items.description: Single-character boxes for a one-time code. Focus moves forward as each box fills, and pasting works.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field, with invalid and disabled states.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row with media, a title, a description and actions, for lists, settings and search results.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut in a small keycap.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A text label for a form control. Clicking it focuses the control it names.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A row of menus like a desktop app bar. Open one, then arrow or hover across the others.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One turn in a conversation. User turns sit right in a bubble; assistant turns read as plain text with actions.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: The browser’s own select, styled to match the theme. Best on mobile and for long option lists.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site navigation with dropdown panels of links, for marketing sites and docs.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Moves through pages of results with numbered links, previous and next.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger, for short forms, settings and details.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Shows how far a task with a known length has come.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: The composer: auto-growing text, tools and a send button. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, and it becomes a stop button while the agent works.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of options where exactly one is selected. Arrow keys move the selection.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels the user can resize by dragging, or with arrow keys on the focused handle.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A fixed-height container that scrolls its content with a thin, theme-coloured scrollbar.

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search Input
items.description: A search field with a shortcut hint, and a clear button once there is a value.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A dropdown for picking one value from a short list, with groups and separators.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline between groups of content, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from any edge over a scrim. Good for edit forms and detail views.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: App navigation that collapses to icons on desktop and becomes a sheet on mobile. Ctrl/⌘+B toggles it.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder blocks that hold the shape of content while it loads.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Picks a number, or a range, by dragging. Arrow keys step through values.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: The Sonner component from machine-ui, styled with theme tokens only.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A spinning ring for work with no known length. Announced to screen readers as loading.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A labelled number with an optional change, marked up or down by icon and text, not colour alone.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status Dot
items.description: A small coloured dot for presence and health, always paired with a text label.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Progress through a fixed sequence of steps, with done, current and upcoming states.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: Streaming Text
items.description: Types a response out with a cursor, then hides the cursor. Shows the whole text at once under reduced motion.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Turns a setting on or off immediately, without a save step.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Composable table parts for simple tabular data. Use Data Table when you need sorting or selection.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between views in the same context. Arrow keys move between tabs.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field that resizes vertically. Use it for messages, notes and descriptions.

items.name: thinking
items.title: Thinking
items.description: The Thinking component from machine-ui, styled with theme tokens only.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A joined row of toggles for picking one option, or several, from a small set.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed, for one on/off option such as a filter or formatting.

items.name: tool-call
items.title: Tool Call
items.description: A tool the agent called, with its status and, on demand, its input and output.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label shown on hover or focus. Never put essential information only in a tooltip.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Text styles on the theme’s fluid type scale: headings use the display face, body uses the text face.
